title: MariaDB current seed verifier thresholds drift from the canonical product seed

rootCause.explanation: The verifier is not projected from seed-model.json. Two minimums exceed the canonical seed while the other two can pass with missing canonical keys.

scope: Canonical product seed model, generated vendor seed SQL, and current MariaDB/PostgreSQL/Oracle verification generator
sourceFix: The official vendor generator derives fail-closed predicates for every distinct canonical business key in all four product-seed tables, handles the idempotent INSERT SELECT row, rejects non-literal keys, and retains a global 100..599 response status invariant for all three vendors.
regeneration: PASS for MariaDB/PostgreSQL/Oracle official source, MariaDB lifecycle/aggregate bundles, and canonical non-table projections
targetedVerification: 12/12 seed/profile regressions PASS; canonical render CHECK PASS; non-table CHECK 15/15 PASS; semantic parity PASS for 234 tables; DDL safety and schema drift PASS
nextAction: Regenerate all official vendor sources, run exact regression/parity gates, and repeat verifier-owned MariaDB Fresh.
